verdict.rationale: Dialpad's API documents several operations that act on multiple items in one call: anonymizing specified contacts, purging recordings and AI data from specified calls, and blocking given phone numbers company-wide. These are narrow, domain-specific endpoints rather than a general bulk-operations capability, and the per-company rate limit of 20 requests/second constrains large-scale work. Missing for 10: general bulk create/update/delete across resources (e.g., users, contacts), documented batch sizes or limits, async bulk job handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Anonymizes the specified contacts by removing all PII (name, phone, email, etc).
Removes call recordings, screen recordings, transcripts, and AI data from the specified calls.
Blocks the given phone numbers company-wide, so that inbound calls and texts from them are rejected for every user in the company.
